topic: Implementing new impression and dwell-time models
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on updating the analytics platform (analytics.allunite.com) with a new default model and implementing a novel impression model for Ocean.

Regarding impressions, it was proposed to implement a model that calculates impressions based on distance from the screen. Since only Kantar's model has been tested so far, a test calculation is required to evaluate the figures and potentially adjust the number of impressions by radius.

The discussion also covered implementing the formula in the code. While only the Kantar version is currently implemented, if the new proposed model is similar, it can be quickly added. Furthermore, the need to incorporate a radius for dwell-time was raised, suggesting that this feature should be implemented immediately and displayed alongside the existing metrics for comparison.
decisions: A test calculation must be performed for the proposed impression model (based on distance from screen).
The new formula/model needs to be implemented in the code base.
action_items: Schedule a call to discuss implementation details and results of the test calculations.
